chunks: Hadith 1789 — The Commander of the Faithful, Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, said:

"Fasting the month of patience and three days of every month removes the anxieties of the chest. And fasting three days in every month is fasting for a lifetime. Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
Whoever comes with a good deed shall have ten times the like of it.

key_terms.بَلَابِلِ الصَّدْرِ: distresses, anxieties, or inner agitation of the chest
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: three days observed as recommended fasting each month
key_terms.شَهْرِ الصَّبْرِ: the month of patience, referring to Ramadan
key_terms.صِيَامُ: fasting as an act of worship
key_terms.عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا: ten times its like in reward

ai.seo_question: Why is fasting three days of every month considered like fasting for a lifetime?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches the merit of fasting the Month of Ramadan and adding three days of fasting each month. He explains that this practice brings inner relief and, by the Qur'anic principle that one good deed is rewarded tenfold, fasting three days every month carries the reward of fasting the whole year.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1789 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"Fasting the month of patience (Month of Ramadan) and three days of every month removes the anxieties of the chest. Fasting three days in every month is equivalent to fasting for a lifetime. Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty, says:
'Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times the like of it.'"
